sections.markdown:
# CPRO.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp61.0 against Rp32.0 (expected total return 90.2%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: washout_rebound · method card: per fund record routing for Poultry, feed & protein.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The multiple-survival test is run on the wrong entry and reports the opposite of its result. Section 4 calls Rp6,141.3bn "the entry enterprise value"; that is the DCF's own EV (74.11 x 59.572 + 1,723.7 + 3.0). What a buy
- Four load-bearing inputs have no source and are jointly fitted to one observation. link1_share 0.10, link2_share 0.22, link1_pass 0.80 and link2_pass 0.80 are all key_input: true and fund record calls them "an order
- The BLOCK flag was cleared with a justification that describes a model the report does not contain. qc_justifications.extreme_call says the links "recover the FY2025 gross margin of 20.1 per cent after the 2026 squeeze, 

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
